title: Extract fieldwork::posts_db — post CRUD, timelines, pagination
description: 153 queries across all 3 servers. The core of every fediverse server. Includes: create_post, get_post, update_post, delete_post, posts_by_persona (paginated), home_timeline (local + remote posts from followed accounts), public_timeline, tag_timeline, thread/context loading, boost resolution, visibility filtering. Also covers post_edits (insert/get history). This is the largest and most complex module.
